# Port of lib/pubid/astm/parser.rb — ASTM designations: standards
# (A-G letter codes, dual-unit, 2-digit years with sub-year letters and
# reapprovals), research reports, TRs, MNL/MONO/DS/WK/ADJ series.

grammar PubidAstm version "0.1.0" edition 2 {
  upper = %x41-5A
  letter = upper / lower
  lower = %x61-7A
  digit = %x30-39
  letters = 1*upper
  digits = 1*digit
  space = " "
  dash = "-"
  slash = "/"
  colon = ":"
  dot = "."
  publisher = ["ASTM" as publisher [space]]
  standard_letter = %x41-47 as letter
  year_2digit = (2*digit) as year
  reapproval = "(" (4digit) as reapproval ")"
  comment = [[space] "#" *non_hash]
  non_hash = %x01-22 / %x24-10FFFF
  edition = {
    (
      ("e" (1*digit) as edition_number)
      / ("9TH" / "8TH" / "7TH" / "6TH" / "5TH" / "4TH" / "3RD" / "2ND" / "1ST") as edition_ordinal
    )
  }
  sub_year = %x61-63 as sub_year
  format_suffix = dash "EB" as format_suffix
  format_suffix_no_dash = "EB" as format_suffix
  supplement = dash "SUP" as supplement dash
  research_report = [publisher] "RR" as type colon (upper 2*digit) as committee dash 1*digit as number
  manual = {
    [publisher]
    "MNL" as type
    ["TP" as tp_designation]
    1*digit as number
    [(dash edition)]
    [
      (supplement [format_suffix_no_dash])
      / [format_suffix]
    ]
  }
  monograph = [publisher] "MONO" as type 1*digit as number [(dash edition)] [format_suffix]
  data_series_suffix = upper as suffix
  data_series_subseries_with_dash = dash "S" 1*digit as subseries
  data_series_subseries_no_dash = 1*digit as subseries
  data_series_code = {
    1*digit as number
    [
      ("HOL" as hol_suffix)
      / (data_series_suffix [(data_series_subseries_no_dash / data_series_subseries_with_dash)])
      / data_series_subseries_with_dash
    ]
  }
  data_series = [publisher] "DS" as type data_series_code [format_suffix]
  work_in_progress = [publisher] "WK" as type 1*digit as number
  adjunct = {
    [publisher]
    "ADJ" as type
    (
      (upper / lower) (1*digit)
      / 1*upper
      / 1*digit
    ) as designation
    ([dash "EA"]) as ea_suffix
    ["DVD" as dvd_suffix]
  }
  technical_report_iso_astm = "ISO/ASTMTR" as type 1*digit as number [format_suffix] [comment]
  technical_report_simple = [publisher] "TR" as type 1*digit as number [format_suffix] [comment]
  technical_report = technical_report_iso_astm / technical_report_simple
  dual_unit = slash standard_letter digits "M" as dual_m
  standard_code_with_letter = standard_letter 1*digit as number [dual_unit]
  standard_code_digit_only = 1*digit as number
  standard = {
    [publisher]
    (standard_code_with_letter / standard_code_digit_only)
    [(dash year_2digit [sub_year] [reapproval] [edition])]
    [comment]
  }
  identifier = {
    research_report
    / technical_report
    / manual
    / monograph
    / data_series
    / work_in_progress
    / adjunct
    / standard
  }

  entry identifier: identifier

  bindings identifier {
    publisher -> publisher (string)
    letter -> letter (string)
    year -> year (string)
    reapproval -> reapproval (string)
    edition_number -> edition_number (string)
    edition_ordinal -> edition_ordinal (string)
    sub_year -> sub_year (string)
    format_suffix -> format_suffix (string)
    supplement -> supplement (string)
    type -> type (string)
    committee -> committee (string)
    number -> number (string)
    tp_designation -> tp_designation (string)
    suffix -> suffix (string)
    subseries -> subseries (string)
    hol_suffix -> hol_suffix (string)
    designation -> designation (string)
    ea_suffix -> ea_suffix (string)
    dvd_suffix -> dvd_suffix (string)
    dual_m -> dual_m (string)
  }

  test {
    accept "ASTM A370-03"
    accept "ASTM E11-87(1996)"
    accept "ASTM RR:D04-1001"
    accept "ASTM DS63"
    reject "nonsense"
  }
}
